item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 24, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Mali Abdoulaye Diop
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇲🇱 On September 24, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Mali Abdoulaye Diop held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Foreign Ministers discussed a wide range of current issues related to further strengthening traditionally friendly Russia-Mali relations , with an emphasis on expanding trade, economic and investment ties in line with the decisions adopted at the second meeting of the Intergovernmental Commission on Cooperation , held in Kazan in May 2026. During an exchange of views on key global and regional issues, the Sides reaffirmed Moscow and Bamako’s commitment to deepening political dialogue based on mutual trust and coordinating their efforts at the UN , including within the Group of Friends in Defense of the UN Charter , as well as at other multilateral platforms. The Russian Side expressed its readiness to continue helping maintain peace and stability in Mali and the Sahara–Sahel region as a whole . #RussiaMali

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 24, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Co-Foreign Minister of Nicaragua Valdrack Jaentschke
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇳🇮 On September 24, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Co-Foreign Minister of Nicaragua Valdrack Jaentschke held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Ministers praised the momentum of political dialogue and the allied nature of cooperation between Moscow and Managua on the international stage. The Sides expressed their mutual readiness to further expand the full range of bilateral ties in the spirit of strategic partnership. Particular attention was paid to the situation in and around Nicaragua in the context of the electoral reform process launched in the country. Sergey Lavrov reaffirmed Russia’s unwavering support for the Nicaraguan Government’s efforts to defend national sovereignty and the right of the brotherly Nicaraguan people to follow their own path of development. #RussiaNicaragua

item.title: ✉️ On September 24, President of Russia Vladimir Putin extended condolences to President of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev.
item.description: ✉️ On September 24, President of Russia Vladimir Putin extended condolences to President of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev. ✍️ Please accept my deep condolences over the tragic incident during Kazakhstan’s naval exercises in the Caspian Sea. I ask you to convey my sincere sympathy and support to the families of the servicemen who lost their lives. We in Russia share their pain and grief. Respectfully, VLADIMIR PUTIN
